author: Repokid
quote: This is all very disappointing, shocking, mediocre, overrated slop. It genuinely feels like your favourite show ending badly. I’ve played GTA all my life and this doesn’t feel like a GTA game. Yes it’s a terrible 30fps launch and yes they can fix it and they will, but I’m not worried about that. I’m more concerned about the repetitive content, boring tasks, woke storyline, and this is what we all have waited 13 years for. They made their money back in a day, and next few months with more people buying it will encourage Rockstar to repeat this same level of anticipation. Not forgetting PC left for last dibs, but these reviews will thankfully help them reconsider.
